jobs.title: Weekend Café Barista – Clubhouse Café
jobs.description: Himalayan Build Co. is opening the Clubhouse Café at its Himalayan Heights residential complex in Satdobato. We need friendly baristas for Friday to Sunday morning service, preparing espresso drinks, tea and light breakfast items for residents and visiting families.
jobs.responsibilities:
Prepare espresso, americano, latte and masala tea to recipe
Take orders and handle cash and QR payments at the counter
Keep the bar, grinder and milk station clean during service
Report milk, bean and syrup stock to the café supervisor

jobs.title: Delivery Rider – Site Material & Document Runs
jobs.description: We need motorbike riders to move small tools, plumbing fittings, signed drawings and invoices between our Baneshwor head office, project sites and suppliers across Kathmandu Valley. Daily route sheets are issued each morning and fuel is reimbursed on top of the daily rate.
jobs.responsibilities:
Collect and deliver parcels and documents on the daily route sheet
Get a signature or photo confirmation for every drop
Keep the motorbike roadworthy and carry the licence and bluebook
Call the dispatcher immediately if a delivery is delayed
jobs.location: Himalayan Build Co. Head Office, Baneshwor, Kathmandu

jobs.title: Data Entry Assistant – Site Inventory & Attendance Records
jobs.description: Help the project accounts team digitise paper stock registers, delivery challans and worker attendance sheets into Excel. Accuracy matters more than speed, and a training sheet is provided on the first day.
jobs.responsibilities:
Enter stock and attendance records into the Excel templates
Cross-check entries against the paper originals
Flag missing or unclear entries to the accounts officer
Save and back up files at the end of each shift

jobs.title: Event Helper – Client Handover Day
jobs.description: Himalayan Heights is handing over Block B apartments to 40 families, and we are hosting a handover day with tents, a reception desk and a tea-and-snacks area. Helpers will set up before guests arrive, guide visitors and pack up in the evening.
jobs.responsibilities:
Set up tents, chairs and the reception desk
Guide families and visitors to the right block
Refill tea, water and snack stations
Help pack up and clean the venue after the event

jobs.title: Banquet Waiter / Waitress – Company Winter Dinner
jobs.description: Himalayan Build Co. is hosting its annual winter dinner for around 150 staff, partners and clients at a banquet hall in Lazimpat. We need confident servers for buffet service, table clearing and drinks service.
jobs.responsibilities:
Set tables and buffet stations before guests arrive
Serve drinks and keep buffet counters stocked
Clear plates and reset tables during the evening
Follow the banquet captain's service order

jobs.title: Social Media Assistant – Project Launch Content
jobs.description: Support our marketing lead with Facebook and Instagram posts for upcoming apartment and showroom launches: simple Canva posters, short captions in Nepali and English, and weekly reach reports. Work can be done partly from home, with two in-person days a week at our Kupondole desk.
jobs.responsibilities:
Design simple posters and story templates in Canva
Write captions in Nepali and English and schedule posts
Reply to basic enquiries on the Facebook page
Send a weekly reach and enquiries summary to the marketing lead

jobs.title: Construction Helper – Apartment Block Finishing
jobs.description: Helpers are needed for finishing work on a residential block in Budhanilkantha: carrying materials, mixing mortar, cleaning floors and assisting masons and plasterers. A site safety briefing, gloves and helmets are provided.
jobs.responsibilities:
Carry bricks, cement and sand to the working floor
Mix mortar and assist masons and plasterers
Keep working areas clear and swept
Follow the site supervisor's safety instructions

jobs.title: Evening Homework Tutor – Community Learning Corner
jobs.description: Our Bhaktapur Greens community learning corner supports children of site staff and nearby families in grades 4 to 8. Tutors guide homework in Maths, English and Science for two hours each evening, Sunday to Friday.
jobs.responsibilities:
Help students complete and revise daily homework
Explain Maths and English concepts with simple examples
Keep a short weekly progress note for each student
Maintain a calm, encouraging classroom
jobs.location: Bhaktapur Greens Learning Corner, Thimi, Bhaktapur

jobs.title: Retail Sales Assistant – Building Materials Showroom
jobs.description: Year-end sale at our Thapathali showroom: greet customers, help them compare tiles, paints and fittings, prepare quotations and process billing with the showroom manager.
jobs.responsibilities:
Greet customers and explain tile, paint and fitting options
Prepare quotations and process bills
Keep display shelves tidy and priced
Record daily sales in the showroom register

jobs.title: Housekeeping Staff – Show-Flat Deep Cleaning
jobs.description: Deep cleaning of two show flats and the clubhouse at Himalayan Heights before the handover inspection: floors, windows, bathrooms, kitchens and post-construction dust removal.
jobs.responsibilities:
Sweep, mop and polish floors in the show flats and clubhouse
Clean windows, bathrooms and kitchen surfaces
Remove post-construction dust and paint marks
Collect and dispose of waste at the designated point

jobs.title: Grocery Store Assistant – Mini-Mart Stocking & Billing
jobs.description: Our Bhaktapur Greens residential mini-mart is receiving its first full stock. Assistants will unload, shelve and label goods, then help at the billing counter during the soft-launch afternoon.
jobs.responsibilities:
Unload and count incoming stock against the challan
Shelve and price-label groceries
Help customers find items
Assist at the billing counter during the soft launch

jobs.title: Canteen Kitchen Helper – Lakeside Resort Project
jobs.description: Kitchen helpers for the staff canteen serving about 60 workers daily at our Pokhara lakeside resort project. Duties include vegetable prep, dal-bhat service, washing up and kitchen hygiene.
jobs.responsibilities:
Wash, peel and chop vegetables for the cook
Serve meals to site workers at lunch
Wash utensils and clean the kitchen after service
Follow basic food hygiene rules

jobs.title: Graphic Design Assistant – Brochure & Signage Pack
jobs.description: Assist our designer with a printable brochure, site hoarding artwork and showroom signage for the next project phase. Brand guidelines and source files are provided.
jobs.responsibilities:
Lay out the brochure from approved copy and photos
Adapt artwork for site hoardings and showroom signage
Export print-ready files in the requested sizes
Make revisions requested by the designer
jobs.qualificationRequired: Diploma or Bachelor's student in design or IT preferred

jobs.title: Office Assistant – Biratnagar Branch Support
jobs.description: Front-desk and filing support for our Biratnagar branch office: answering calls, logging visitors, filing site documents and running local bank and municipality errands.
jobs.responsibilities:
Answer calls and log visitors at the front desk
File and label site documents
Run errands to the bank and municipality office
Keep the office tidy and supplies stocked

jobs.title: Seasonal Delivery Rider – Showroom Orders
jobs.description: Extra riders to deliver paint, tiles and fittings from our Koteshwor warehouse to customers across the valley during the busy buying season.
jobs.responsibilities:
Load orders at the warehouse and verify the delivery list
Deliver to customer addresses and collect signatures
Report damaged goods or failed deliveries the same day
Return the delivery sheet to the dispatcher by 5 pm

jobs.title: Launch Day Helper – Butwal Showroom Opening
jobs.description: Helpers for the opening day of our new Butwal showroom: welcoming visitors, handing out brochures, managing the entrance queue and assisting with refreshments.
jobs.responsibilities:
Welcome visitors and hand out brochures
Manage the entrance queue and parking guidance
Assist with refreshments and clean-up
